analysis.archetype_style: Explosive fencer who relies on fast, decisive attacks.

fencer1.archetype_style: Explosive fencer who relies on fast, decisive attacks.
fencer1.rationale: You relied on your quick reflexes to score points, but struggled to create clear attacking opportunities. Your opponent's fast attacks forced you to react quickly and defend effectively. Despite being pushed forward more often, you still managed to outscore them with precise touches.
fencer1.targeting_notes: Focus on creating clearer attacking paths by using your lunge and counter more consistently.

practice_suggestions.detail: Start in a neutral position, then quickly switch to a lunge attack, followed by a counter attack. Repeat this sequence several times, focusing on maintaining good footwork and timing.
practice_suggestions.focus: Developing your attack mix and creating clearer paths to the target.
practice_suggestions.title: Lunge-Counter Drill
practice_suggestions.why: Practice generating clear attacking opportunities by alternating between lunge and counter attacks.

practice_suggestions.detail: Stand at a comfortable distance from your opponent, then quickly attempt a fleche attack on their arm or leg. Focus on using your wrist and forearm to generate power and control.
practice_suggestions.focus: Enhancing your precision with fleche attacks.
practice_suggestions.title: Fleche-Target Drill
practice_suggestions.why: Improve your accuracy with fleche attacks by targeting specific areas of the opponent's body.

practice_suggestions.detail: Start in a defensive position, then quickly react to an opponent's fast attack. Focus on using your body positioning and footwork to create space and time to counterattack.
practice_suggestions.focus: Developing your ability to handle pressure and create counterattacking opportunities.
practice_suggestions.title: Pressure-Countering Drill
practice_suggestions.why: Practice countering your opponent's fast attacks by staying calm and focused under pressure.
